messages.text: BL-1770 🎵 in progress — briefingDigestLineCli.test.js times out at 20 s in the unit lane (QA, BL-1766 parcel, 2026-09-26) because three of its tests run the digest CLI against the LIVE repository and derive every backlog lifecycle from its whole git history - 11.5 s, 10.5 s and 8.8 s each run alone at load 15 - the same work that makes it a 36.3 s duration pole: the three wiring tests run against a small mkdtemp git fixture, so the timeout red and the pole leave together
